explanation: Removed WTA-owned per-session /yolo controls and the SetSessionYolo flow, eliminating the fallback opt-in/opt-out path that could leave a local override enabled.
evidence: The commit deletes the reserved /yolo command, on/off overrides, completion handling, and SetSessionYolo request path.
At 17bc4828, Copilot still uses generic config_channel, which accepts values containing on plus the current value and can use a non-off current value as restore_value.
At 17bc4828, config_channel still calls find on id/category first and checks SessionConfigKind::Select only afterward, so an earlier non-Select match can hide a valid later selector.
